info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Human Resource Management Recruitments-spec
info.description: This API provides access to a comprehensive list of recruitment activities within the Human Resource Management framework. It allows users to retrieve vital information about ongoing and past recruitment efforts, ensuring visibility into HR operations. Typical consumers include HR professionals, recruitment agencies, and analytics teams who aim to monitor recruitment metrics or enhance their hiring strategies. By integrating this API, organizations can streamline their recruitment processes and make informed decisions based on real-time data.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to access detailed information regarding recruitment processes within the human resource management system, including available positions and application statuses.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving recruitment information within the Human Resource Management system. This request may include various parameters to filter and specify the recruitment data that is desired.

200.description: The request was executed successfully, and the recruitment data is returned.

ListHumanResourceManagementRecruitmentsR.description: Represents the request body for retrieving human resource management recruitment operations.
